name: MaintainX to Relay bridge
description: Turns MaintainX work order webhooks into spoken Relay alerts and broadcasts.

RELAY_SUBSCRIBER_ID.description: Relay Dash > Help > Diagnostic Logs > Server Details > Subscriber

MAINTAINX_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: MaintainX > Settings > Integrations > Webhooks > Copy secret

RELAY_ROUTES.description: JSON: route name -> { mode, groups, ...alert options }

MAINTAINX_API_KEY.description: Optional. Adds titles and locations to spoken alerts.

DRY_RUN.description: true logs Relay requests instead of sending them
